why: New iPhone builds made from main while iPhone kept no release branch (2026-10-26 to 2026-11-05), so no run tagged them: build 45 (PR 250, the public one on 2026-11-05) and each merge after it that changed the iPhone fingerprint (npx @expo/fingerprint at each merge). scripts/release-branches.mjs tags each as rebuild/ios/<commit> and starts release/ios from the commit before the first one whose build is not public (decisions.md 155).
